title: Random-matrix and transport frequencies in eigenstate spectral functions
summary: The fact that generic isolated many-body quantum systems thermalize is understood using the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH). In recent years, there has been much interest in the behavior of the ETH spectral functions, which characterize the smooth dependence of the variance of the off-diagonal matrix elements of observables on the associated energy and frequency, and whose low-frequency part contains information about the long-time dynamics. In finite systems described by the ETH, the spectral functions are expected to exhibit plateaus below a characteristic frequency…
